title: Define typed content-part model with fixed kinds and extra passthrough
description: Fixed kind set: text, thinking, tool_call, tool_result, attachment, system; agent-specific data outside the kinds flows through an extensible extra/raw passthrough without loss. Done when: every part kind round-trips through JSON and unknown kinds degrade to extra.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: KnownPart has the fixed kinds (text, thinking, tool_call, tool_result, attachment, inline_data, blob, system) plus Part::Extra raw passthrough. Golden round-trip unit tests in src/schema/mod.rs prove every kind survives JSON (kind tag intact) and unknown kinds degrade to Extra verbatim (kind_name + as_extra); message_parts.feature drives the same behavior. All gates green.

right_now_summary: The typed content-part model preserves known and unknown kinds through JSON round-trips.
